title: GOOSE 3D validation split measured in full — 961 frames, 174.9M labelled points
dataset: GOOSE 3D validation split, archive downloaded 2026-08-22 from goose-dataset.de
sensor_configuration: Velodyne Alpha Prime 128-channel roof LiDAR only. The MuCAR-3 platform also carries 2x Ouster OS0 32-channel, 7 cameras and 6 Smartmicro radars, none of which appear in this archive.
annotation_schema: GOOSE 64-class pointwise semantic labels, SemanticKITTI .label format (uint32, semantic in low 16 bits)
split: validation, all 961 paired LiDAR/label frames across 8 scenarios
conditions: Four seasons, rain and sun, forest, farmland, campus and hills

environment.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660, 6144 MiB VRAM (not used for this run)

notes: The range distribution is why GOOSE cannot serve decision D-04. Only 3.8% of labelled points lie beyond 100 m and 1.1% beyond 150 m, so there is almost no data in the band D-04 asks about — a firmer reason than the task mismatch alone. The 22 sparse classes are why R5 defines mIoU over a declared class set rather than blindly averaging over all 64.
